title: Supplier validation of CSOS electronic orders
rule_summary: A supplier receiving a CSOS electronic controlled-substance order must validate the DEA-issued digital certificate and the electronic order; an order signed with an expired, revoked, or otherwise invalid certificate may not be treated as a valid electronic Schedule I/II order.
exam_relevance: Tests the supplier-side validity gate after an electronic order is received rather than who is allowed to possess a certificate.
common_confusions: Assuming an electronically transmitted purchase order is valid merely because it arrived through the wholesaler's CSOS-capable portal.
verification_notes: Current official primary or official agency source checked on 2026-08-14.
